newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aunt calls Versace killer "nice, quiet boy".
newsitem.headline: Aunt calls Versace killer "nice, quiet boy".

text.p: Andrew Cunanan, who apparently committed suicide when cornered by Miami Beach police hunting him in the murder of fashion king Gianni Versace, was a nice, quiet boy from a religious family, his aunt said on Thursday.

"I couldn't believe this happened. He was a nice boy and he was very quiet. The family was very religious and they would go to church together," Barbara Cunanan Carlos told Reuters in this small town north of Manila.
She also recalled Cunanan used to be an altar boy when he was growing up in the United States.
The house in the nearby town of Plaridel in Bulacan province where Cunanan's Filipino father, Modesto Cunanan, lived was deserted.

Neighbours said he left with a female companion a week ago. They said they saw a Caucasian woman with a child come to the house earlier in the week but she drove away after seeing it was empty and locked.
Cunanan was the son of Modesto and his first wife. He was brought up in the United States, where his father worked for the U.S. Navy. There were three other children.

"They had a good family. Modesto took care of them well. Their children were studying in exclusive schools and the mother was very religious. She would go to church every morning. It was a beautiful family," the aunt said.
"They were all beautiful children. It is only now that they all broke up. I don't know why... Maybe, life is like that," she said at her large home in this small town north of Manila.
The aunt, 64, last saw Cunanan in 1988 when he made his only known visit to his father's homeland.
The aunt, who is in the retail clothing business, said she had lost contact with the family and only discovered her brother was living nearby from news reports after Versace's murder.
Versace, who dressed the world's beautiful and famous, was shot dead on July 15 at the gate of his ocean-front mansion in Miami Beach.
Cunanan was the only suspect in the killing and was also wanted for the murders of four other men.

On Wednesday night, a police assault team stormed a houseboat on Miami Beach and found the body of a white man who bore a similarity to Cunanan, police chief Richard Barreto said. Final confirmation that the body is Cunanan's has yet to be made.
"I was praying for him that he would surrender so that all of this would be over. We are just a peaceful people. But now my husband was almost getting a heart attack," the aunt said.
She said the two families were not very close.
But, "of course I feel sad, because he had links with our family... They have a different tradition... They don't meddle with us and they don't want us to meddle with them".
